metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the rolls, Kemp's empty hand, a plain second reading, Gaunt on a stool, and the walk home by every wall.

yesterday: Kemp has the jig and the whole stage to himself, and he took it as a groat in settlement of a pound. He and the Master, by his saying, are served alike, and the deposing stays cut.
Burbage's joins came back on the second plain reading.
The armour-basket answered in the back. Gaunt, for the rest of the morning, was a stool. Burbage called that the best thing in it.
This afternoon's Titus is the company's, and you came home by every wall. Tomorrow you are seated if the back is still yesterday's, and at two you are Egeon again.
